parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, Cox's Motor Homes, Dave Sparrow speaking.

Oh, hi, I would like to inquire about renting an RV for a week. I think you call them motor homes in the UK.

Yes, we do. Well, we should be able to help you there. So what type were you thinking of?

It's just for two of us, me and my husband.

Right, the best model for you would be the "two-berth end kitchen." That's the one with the sitting and sleeping area in the middle and the other facilities at the back.

Yes, that sounds good. And what sort of price is that?

The cost starts at £545 a week, depending on when you want it. If it's high season, it goes up to £755.

And is that all-inclusive?

There's what we call a damage deposit. That's fully refundable if the vehicle is returned in good condition. That depends on the driver's age. You do have to be at least 21 to drive one of these vehicles.

That's okay. I'm 24.

Well, in that case, if you're driving the vehicle, the deposit would be £460. It goes down to £250 for drivers of 26 and above.

And do I have to pay more if my husband drives as well?

No, extra drivers are free.

Great. We have to pay a supplement for that in the States.

So you've driven one of these before, have you?

Yes, but only in America. Oh, that reminds me about my driving license. I've got an international one. Is that okay?

That's fine.

And I just have a few questions about the motor homes, if that's all right.

Go ahead.

So, first of all, can you tell me how old your vehicles are on average?

They're all less than 30 months, so you're getting a vehicle in peak condition.

Okay. And I'd prefer an automatic gearbox if possible. Can you do that?

I'm afraid not. They're all manual. Will that be a problem?

Oh, I guess I'll be okay. It was just a thought.

And also, our customers sometimes ask if they can bring their pets along. So if you wanted to do that, it's fine, as long as you make sure they're properly looked after.

Oh, well, that won't apply to us, but it's nice to know.

And I suppose there are cooking facilities in the motor home?

Yes, there's everything you need for cooking.

Like a fridge?

Yes, and you've got a built-in microwave, too.

And you said it sleeps two. So is that two singles or a double?

You can arrange the bed either way. And you've got a CD player . And we've installed a television in every motor home as well.

Right. Well, that might be useful if we have a rainy day. Oh, and what about Satnav? I don't suppose that's included, is it?

Sure. We've had that in all our motor homes for a few years now. Our customers really appreciate it.

Great. Oh, and what about a rack for my bicycle? I'd like to take it along.

Yes, we can arrange for that.

Now, what happens about electricity? I think we'll probably be staying at campsites most of the time. So presumably there'll be mains hookup there. But we're going to a music festival for a couple of days, and I don't think they have hookups there, so we'll need a generator.

It's not included, but we can hire one for you. It'll be £50 for a week.

Now about collection. I know your company's near Salisbury. We'll be coming from London. So what's the best way for us to get to you?

We'll be arriving by train.

Well, if you want, we can pick you up from the station. The nearest station to us is Grateley.

I'm sorry?

Grateley. That's spelled G-R-A-T-E-L-E-Y. There's no charge for that. Just let us know when you'll be arriving. So, would you like to go ahead and book a vehicle now?

Yes. So my name is Christy and my...

analyses.content: 女士今年24岁，男士查看表格后确认，对于26岁以下的驾驶员，押金是 460 英镑。
That's okay. I'm 24. Well, in that case, if you're driving the vehicle, the deposit would be £460. It goes down to £250 for drivers of 26 and above.
不要听到后面的 250 就填，那是给26岁以上（26 and above）老司机的价格。
And do I have to pay more if my husband drives as well? No, extra drivers are free. Great.
虽然在聊husband，但这只是个例，填空需要填入男士所说的通用规则中的词汇。
女士询问如果丈夫也开车是否要加钱，男士回答 extra drivers（额外的司机）是免费的。
Oh, that reminds me about my driving license. I've got an international one. Is that okay? That's fine.
不要听到 America 就填 American，那只是她开过车的地方，不是驾照的类型。
女士提到她持有的是 international（国际）驾照，并询问是否可用，男士表示没问题。
Okay. And I'd prefer an automatic gearbox if possible. Can you do that? I'm afraid not. They're all manual.
千万别填 automatic，这是女士想要但被拒绝的选项。
女士想要自动挡，但男士遗憾地表示他们所有的房车都是 manual（手动挡）的。
And also, our customers sometimes ask if they can bring their pets along. So if you wanted to do that, it's fine, as long as you make sure they're properly looked after.
答案必须复数，原文中明确说了 "bring their pets"。
男士主动提到，如果顾客想要带 pets（宠物）是可以的，只要照顾好它们就行。
谈到烹饪设施，女士具体询问有没有 fridge（冰箱），男士确认有，并补充说还有微波炉。
Yes, there's everything you need for cooking. Like a fridge? Yes, and you've got a built-in microwave, too.
Microwave 是已知信息，不要填重复了；另外注意 fridge 的拼写（带有 d）。
You can arrange the bed either way. And you've got a CD player. And we've installed a television in every motor home as well.
不要填 CD player，那是前一句提到的东西，题目暗示是 "new this year" 或者并在列举的项目。
除了CD播放器，男士补充说他们在每辆房车里都安装了 television（电视）。
Great. Oh, and what about a rack for my bicycle? I'd like to take it along. Yes, we can arrange for that.
注意拼写，不要写成 bike，虽然口语常用，但填空题优先使用原文出现的标准词汇。
女士想带自行车，所以询问是否可以提供一个 bicycle rack（自行车架）。
But we're going to a music festival for a couple of days, and I don't think they have hookups there, so we'll need a generator. It's not included, but we can hire one for you.
不要填 hookup，那是露营地才有的东西，正是因为没有它才需要发电机。
女士说要去音乐节，那里没有主电源接口，所以她指出需要租一个 generator（发电机）。
Well, if you want, we can pick you up from the station. The nearest station to us is Grateley. I'm sorry? Grateley. That's spelled G-R-A-T-E-L-E-Y.
不要填 Salisbury，那是公司所在的大致区域，不是具体的接人站点；也不要填 London，那是出发地。
男士提供了最近的火车站名字 Grateley，并进行了拼写。
